acceptedReviewDebt.summary: A person whose name is a registry entry classifies NON_PERSON: 'Should Dow buy Nvidia?', 'Should Apple Martin buy Nvidia?'.
acceptedReviewDebt.whyNotFixed: Every name registry has this property. Closing it needs either full-span matching, which breaks 'the Dow Jones Industrial Average', or a personal-name list, which is the unbounded enumeration the classifier exists to avoid. Every phrasing carrying any other personal cue — a possessive on the object, a kinship word, a role, an instruction frame — is covered.
acceptedReviewDebt.assignedBy: the Gate O review, and not re-filed by Gates P through U
